layers.name: Foundation
layers.description: Local inference and model execution. The base layer where intelligence runs on your hardware.
layers.problem: AI systems depend on cloud infrastructure. Local inference provides sovereignty.
layers.why_matters: Everything above depends on local-first inference. If you can't run intelligence locally, you have no sovereignty.

layers.name: Infrastructure
layers.description: Infrastructure for running, securing, and deploying sovereign intelligence.
layers.problem: Sovereignty isn't just about running locally — it's about security, trust, and deployment at scale.
layers.why_matters: Security and deployment infrastructure ensures sovereign systems are robust and trustworthy.

layers.name: Retrieval
layers.description: Persistent, structured knowledge that compounds over time.
layers.problem: Agents forget between sessions. Vector stores retrieve — they don't understand.
layers.why_matters: Memory is the key differentiator between a one-shot LLM and sovereign intelligence.

layers.name: Planning
layers.description: Turn knowledge into understanding, reports, and broadcasts.
layers.problem: Retrieval alone is just storage. Planning makes intelligence actionable.
layers.why_matters: Planning transforms raw knowledge into synthesized understanding.

layers.name: Reasoning
layers.description: Treat specifications as living, graph-grounded artifacts.
layers.problem: Software specifications are static documents. They don't evolve or connect to knowledge.
layers.why_matters: Reasoning is the bridge from research to implementable systems.

layers.name: Orchestration
layers.description: Coordinate multiple specialized agents into coherent intelligence.
layers.problem: Individual components are useless without orchestration.
layers.why_matters: Orchestration turns a collection of parts into an integrated whole.

layers.name: Applications
layers.description: Real systems that demonstrate the stack in practice.
layers.why_matters: Applications prove that sovereign intelligence is not theoretical — it can be built and used today.

title: Sovereign Intelligence Stack
subtitle: One evolving architecture. Seven layers. Eighty repositories testing one hypothesis.
narrative: Intelligence can be locally owned. This architecture demonstrates that hypothesis through implementation.
